senses.definition: n.m. bowl (NH id.; 𝔗 כְּפוֹרָא)—bowl of gold or silver, used in the temple (late), כ׳ 1 Ch 28:17(×4); pl. cstr. כְּפוֹרֵי 1 Ch 28:17(×2) Ezr 1:10(×2); 8:27.
